answer: The glazier shop is cold and bright, and the glass sheets lean against the wall in their crates. Proof of glazier via pane cut tally — a pane the glazier cuts only after 24 panes sit clear in the sash, each pane cut by the glazier himself. ember scores the pane with the diamond and snaps it along the line. grove sets the glass in the sash and beds it in putty. reef trims the points and wipes the pane till it runs clear. A man faking it needs 24 panes cut without a single crack, and the twenty-fifth still splits at the corner.
